_doc: First matching rule wins. prefixes: utterance must START with one (case-insensitive; trailing ,:，：、 and spaces are stripped, ASCII prefixes need a word boundary); the prefix is removed from the body. keywords: utterance CONTAINS it anywhere (body unchanged). action: append (target file under inbox/) | ask (claude -p, answer to inbox/answers/<id>.md). Anything unmatched goes to default.
